title: Evaluation of derived coefficient comparison on one model
statement: In the ring setting of [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model], fix a derived coefficient transformation tau satisfying the representative equation [lem-pc-base-tensor-derived-comparison]. Let P be one A-complex and M its base-derived tensor cohomology model. Let zeta:M.derived iso F be counit-compatible. Let s identify H^i(L(Q(P))) with H^i(D tensor_A P), with forward map exactly the scalar-extension counit homology map. The B-restriction of the adjoint transpose of M.localizedComparison followed by s inverse equals M.cohomologyIso followed by H^i(M.derived(c_P);zeta at Res_R Q(P)) followed by tau at Q(P). This is an evaluation formula at one complex, with no second model or derived morphism.

proof.text: Form beta from M.ordinaryIso and B-restriction of M.ordinaryToLocalized. Their generator formulas give the representative coefficient equation; apply the defining representative equation of tau.

Cancel restriction of s.hom; substitute M.localized_eq. Naturality of zeta with c_P inverse and its counit compatibility reduce the derived maps to M.counit. Homology of a composite and naturality of the B-restriction homology isomorphism reduce beta to ordinaryIso followed by restriction of ordinaryToLocalized. Substitute comparison_eq and cancel the homology isomorphism and its inverse.
